result.rationale: The diff shows handleAdd does `if (multiEmailValue.length === 0) { return; }` with no feedback, and MultiEmail allows removing all rows (splice) leaving value=[] when it started as [""] in useState. In that state clicking Add silently does nothing — no error message, no visible response. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; severity is minor UX, but it is real behavior introduced by this change.

judged_text: Client: handleAdd returns silently when multiEmailValue is empty (all rows removed), leaving an unresponsive-looking Add button

record.issue_text: Client: handleAdd returns silently when multiEmailValue is empty (all rows removed), leaving an unresponsive-looking Add button

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.handleAdd`, when `multiEmailValue.length === 0` it `return`s without any feedback or disabling the Add button. This state is reachable because `MultiEmail` allows removing rows via `onClickAddon` (splicing the array), which can leave `value` as `[]`. The dialog footer Add button remains clickable but does nothing, matching the finding’s “unresponsive-looking Add button”.
